# PART 3 – Reproduction and exploration {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 3 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Welcome back. This is the coding-heavy part. The first two parts were mostly concepts, and now we put them to work. You reproduce the value that Multi100 recorded for one of the five analysts, whichever you choose, from the public file of the original study, and then find out why your number is exactly that number. Then we open the menu of choices that any analyst of this claim faces, go through what the main ones do to the model, and you spend the last stretch working the menu yourself. By the end of it you will have a feel for which of those choices move the answer and which barely touch it.
:::
